For vendors

Privacy policy

Last updated: 17 October 2026

Customer terms Customer privacy Vendor terms Vendor privacy

This Privacy Policy explains how Queueless collects, uses, and protects personal data when a business uses the Queueless vendor web or mobile tools in Kenya. We handle personal data in line with the Data Protection Act, 2019 of Kenya. People who use the customer app are covered by the separate customer privacy policy.

1. Data we collect

  • Account data: mobile phone number, a hashed PIN, and the username on the account.
  • Verification data: one-time passcodes sent to your phone and related delivery timestamps.
  • Business data: business name, category, branch names, addresses, map coordinates, optional branch phone numbers, and the services you list.
  • Operations data: queue entries, bookings, and walk-in details you enter, such as a guest name, phone number, and party size.
  • Technical data: notification tokens from the vendor app on a device, and basic usage information needed to operate and secure the tools.

2. How we use your data

  • To create and secure the vendor account, including phone verification via SMS.
  • To publish the business and branches you choose to show, and to run queues, walk-ins, and bookings.
  • To send customers the queue messages you trigger, where SMS is enabled for that business.
  • To provide support, prevent abuse, and meet legal obligations.

3. Customer details you enter

When you add a walk-in or otherwise type a customer’s name or phone number, you decide to put that information into Queueless. Enter only what you need to serve that person, and only where you have a proper reason to hold it. We use those details to run the queue and, where you ask us to, to send the related SMS.

4. Sharing

We share information only as needed to run the service:

  • Customers see the business, branch, service, queue, and booking information you publish or that relates to their own visit.
  • SMS and email providers process messages on our behalf (for example verification codes and queue messages).
  • We may disclose information if required by Kenyan law or a lawful request from authorities.

We do not sell personal data.

5. Retention

We keep account, business, and queue records for as long as the account remains active and for a reasonable period afterwards to resolve disputes, meet legal requirements, and maintain security logs. You can delete your account at any time in the app or on our account deletion page, or by writing to hello@queueless.co.ke.

6. Security

We use industry-standard measures to protect data, including hashing PINs and restricting access to personal information. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

7. Your rights

Under the Data Protection Act, 2019 you may have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data, and to object to or restrict certain processing. To exercise these rights, email hello@queueless.co.ke.

8. Children

The vendor tools are for businesses and are not directed at children. Do not enter a child’s personal data unless you have a proper reason and any consent the law requires.

9. Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top of this page will change when we do.

10. Contact

For privacy questions or requests, email hello@queueless.co.ke.
